switches.name: Blur
switches.tip: Blurs a source and clears it again. The key shows which way it is.

switches.name: Shadow, Glow & Outline
switches.tip: Switches a source's shadow, glow or outline on and off.

switches.name: Corners & Edges
switches.tip: Switches a source's shaped corners and edges on and off.

switches.name: Zoom
switches.tip: Zooms a source in and back out.

switches.name: Auto Capture
switches.tip: Switches automatic game capture on and off. On hands a hooked capture back to it.

switches.name: Auto Frame
switches.tip: Switches a capture's automatic framing on and off.

switches.name: Standby Image
switches.tip: Switches the image shown while nothing is captured on and off, or (On press: Cover) shows that image over any source now, a camera too, and takes it away.

switches.name: Show in Scenes
switches.tip: Shows and hides sources across scenes with one switch. Each key can hide them, or cover them with their Standby Image.

switches.name: Fit to Space
switches.tip: Switches a scene's fitting of its game or window on and off.

switches.name: Automatic Source Switcher
switches.tip: Switches a scene's automatic switching between sources on and off.

switches.name: Automatic Window Switcher
switches.tip: Switches a Window Capture's automatic switching between windows on and off.

switches.name: Program Trigger
switches.tip: Switches a program trigger on and off.

switches.name: Link Visibility
switches.tip: Switches a link between items' visibility on and off.

switches.name: Show/Hide Animation
switches.tip: Switches a scene's show and hide animations on and off.

switches.name: Scene Fit
switches.tip: Switches a scene's Scene Fit on and off: the fitting of its sources into the free space.

switches.name: Scene Shadow
switches.tip: Switches a scene's one shadow, glow or outline round its sources on and off.

switches.name: Scene Corners
switches.tip: Switches the corners and edges a Scene Corners gives a scene's sources on and off.

switches.name: Scene Standby
switches.tip: Switches a scene's Scene Standby on and off: the standby image for every empty capture in it.

switches.name: Match Item
switches.tip: Switches a scene's Match Item filter on or off. The filter keeps its configured items matched to their reference.

switches.name: Scene Transitions
switches.tip: Switches this scene's source show and hide transitions on or off.

moves.name: Move Source
moves.tip: Sends the camera, or any source, to one of its saved places.

moves.name: Move Scene Item
moves.tip: Moves a scene's item to its place.

moves.name: Apply Layout
moves.tip: Puts a scene's items into a saved layout.

scenes.name: Scene Blur
scenes.tip: Blurs a scene's sources with its Scene Blur filter: on one scene, or on every scene that has a Scene Blur of that name. Lit while it is on.

timer.name: Countdown Timer
timer.tip: Set and start a StageKit timer at the next clock mark, or start, pause or stop it.

view.name: View
view.tip: Selects a saved Scene Controller group choice or combined view, shared with the StageKit Views dock. Shows the state reported by OBS.

autoFrameCommands.name: Measure Bars
autoFrameCommands.title:
Measure
Bars
autoFrameCommands.tip: Measures the current captured image and shows its detected aspect ratio.

autoFrameCommands.name: Remember Aspect Ratio
autoFrameCommands.title:
Remember
Ratio
autoFrameCommands.tip: Saves the current detected aspect ratio for the captured application or window name.

autoFrameCommands.name: Measure and Remember
autoFrameCommands.title:
Measure &
Remember
autoFrameCommands.tip: Measures a fresh image, then saves that result for the selected application or window name.

sceneStarts.name: Move Source in Scene
sceneStarts.tip: Starts a StageKit Move Source scene filter.

sceneStarts.name: Swap Sources in Scene
sceneStarts.tip: Starts a StageKit Move Source Swap scene filter.
